name: stufently-mcp
description: Claude Code plugins for stufently's MCP servers: each one bundles the server with safe defaults and ready-made scenarios

plugins.name: zabbix-ai-cli-mcp
plugins.description: Zabbix: what is broken now, investigate an alert, why a notification did or did not arrive. Read-only by default.

plugins.name: google-webtools-mcp
plugins.description: Google Search Console and GA4: check a page's indexing, weekly SEO review.

plugins.name: bing-webmaster-ai-cli-mcp
plugins.description: Bing Webmaster: check a page's crawl and index state, review Bing traffic. Writes only as plans a person applies.

plugins.name: yandex-metrica-mcp
plugins.description: Yandex Metrica: traffic report and goal conversions for a counter.

plugins.name: aviasales-mcp
plugins.description: Aviasales: find the cheapest flight for a route, a month or a budget.

plugins.name: telegram-ai-cli-mcp
plugins.description: Telegram user account: triage unread and mentions, and prepare every write as a plan a person applies. The plugin lives in its own repository; requires `tg-ai` on PATH.
